scope: Shared design variables in existing identity and colour-story styles; private generated production-component reference.

preview.access: loopback-only server; generated files ignored and excluded from public/dist; no public navigation link

decisions: Retain all existing colour and font values; add named spacing, size, weight, radius, layout and target variables.
Use existing --kid naming instead of a parallel token system.
Token replacements retain numerical values; book decorative redesign and Studio production styles unchanged.
Effective heading weight was already 600 due to a late !important rule; preserve and name it.
Reference extracts a current homepage card and imports actual production styles. Separate frames isolate actual book and Studio CSS.
Local controls validate/demo only; no account access, submission, storage or publication.

guidance.quote: Check for any existing conventions around naming and levels before inventing your own.
guidance.application: Retained --kid naming and extended existing shared root tokens. Scoped/layered private reference styles; no new dependency or global reset.

limitations: Browser checks, integrated test/build and separate review belong to coordinator before completion.
Reference is a targeted component specimen, not every legacy page or accessibility certification.
Fonts/assets require supplied loopback preview server; file:// opening is not supported.
